title: Expose stable application destinations
description: Create the semantic application-shell navigation contract for the five stable destinations: Projects, Sheet layouts, Printing setups and calibration, Assets, and Settings and backup.
acceptanceCriteria: All five PRD-defined destination names appear in primary navigation
Each destination has a stable route or destination identifier
Activating a destination renders its matching heading and marks it as current
Navigation uses semantic links or equivalent native controls

steps.details: Add one typed, ordered destination definition containing the exact five names and stable route identifiers so labels are not duplicated across the shell.
Render the destination definition inside a named navigation landmark using native links or buttons appropriate to the routing approach.
Render a destination heading and programmatic current marker such as `aria-current="page"` for the active destination.
Add a focused browser assertion that each semantic navigation item is reachable and activates the correctly named destination without relying on component internals.

technicalNotes: Keep routing private to the standalone application; do not introduce a public package API.
Use canonical destination labels exactly as written in PRD 14.
